The most environmentally friendly method of sandblasting is provided by our Dustless Blasting equipment. In contrast to sandblasting, the abrasive we use is combined with water so that all of the media and any airborne particles may be contained. Because the sand is combined with water, there is no risk of the metal becoming distorted as a result of the heat generated by typical sandblasting. In contrast to traditional sandblasting, our method does not create any risks to public safety or the environment. We now provide this service as a mobile-friendly alternative for your convenience.

Dustless Sandblasting

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.22.2″ _module_preset=”4994b8c3-6366-4eb7-bd02-a5f482f9dc94″ text_text_color=”gcid-6f6a8773-a8ec-4359-8e89-23c106a6429d” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-6f6a8773-a8ec-4359-8e89-23c106a6429d%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}”]

The most environmentally friendly method of sandblasting is provided by our Dustless Blasting equipment. In contrast to sandblasting, the abrasive we use is combined with water so that all of the media and any airborne particles may be contained. Because the sand is combined with water, there is no risk of the metal becoming distorted as a result of the heat generated by typical sandblasting. In contrast to traditional sandblasting, our method does not create any risks to public safety or the environment. Mold, rust, automotive paint, industrial epoxy, powder coating, calcium, oil, and grease are just some of the substances that we are able to remove from practically any surface. We now provide this service as a mobile-friendly alternative for your convenience.

Powder Coating

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.23″ _module_preset=”4994b8c3-6366-4eb7-bd02-a5f482f9dc94″ text_text_color=”gcid-6f6a8773-a8ec-4359-8e89-23c106a6429d” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{%22gcid-6f6a8773-a8ec-4359-8e89-23c106a6429d%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}”]

Because we make use of the latest advancements in finishing technology, every powder coating project we complete at Legacy Metal Works is of the highest possible quality. Our professional-grade process ensures that each piece receives an even, durable coat that resists chipping, scratching, and fading.  With our wide range of colors, textures, and finishes, we are able to meet a variety of customer needs—whether you want a bold, eye-catching look or a sleek, subtle finish. Powder coating also provides long-lasting protection against rust and corrosion, making it an excellent choice for both indoor and outdoor applications. If you have a specific vision for your project, our team can help bring it to life with a custom finish that matches your exact specifications. Every item is coated and cured right here in our workshop, giving you confidence that your metalwork will not only look exceptional but also stand the test of time.
